title: Emergent order spectrum for transitive homeomorphisms
summary: The Emergent Order Spectrum $Ω(x,y)$ is a topological invariant of dynamical systems providing order-types induced by the limit order of order-compatible nested $\varepsilon_n$-chains (with $\varepsilon_n\to 0$) from $x$ to $y$. In this paper, we investigate how rich these spectra can be under natural dynamical hypotheses.
